recognize_zh: 右上方一群大型細胞，核圓、染色質細緻、細胞質豐富淡藍且邊界不清、彼此融合，並有散在深色顆粒，與周圍較小的顆粒球系細胞截然不同，符合非造血的轉移性癌細胞團；但單一視野下難與組織球或造骨細胞完全區分。
features: Loose aggregate of large cells (upper right) with round-to-oval nuclei, fine chromatin and abundant pale basophilic cytoplasm with indistinct, syncytial borders
Scattered dark coarse granules/debris over the cytoplasm of the aggregate
Large single cell (lower center) with a round nucleus and abundant finely vacuolated cytoplasm
Admixed smaller hematopoietic cells: myelocytes/band forms, a small lymphocyte and a nucleated red cell
Hemodilute background with lysed red cells and a large clear fat space; no tight three-dimensional cohesion in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a hemodilute background with scattered myeloid and erythroid precursors. There is a loose aggregate of large cells with round nuclei, fine chromatin and abundant pale blue cytoplasm with indistinct syncytial borders, as well as a large cell with abundant finely vacuolated cytoplasm; these cells are several times the size of adjacent granulocytes. Cohesion is less pronounced in this field than in classic tumor clusters, and distinction from macrophages or osteoblasts is limited on a single field. In the context of known gastric carcinoma, findings are suggestive of metastatic carcinoma, which should be confirmed on the trephine biopsy with cytokeratin immunohistochemistry.

ddx.vs: Macrophages occur singly with kidney-shaped nuclei and phagocytosed debris or hemosiderin, and do not form syncytial groups of nuclei with high N:C variation; CD68/CD163 versus cytokeratin resolves it.
Osteoblasts have eccentric nuclei with a pale perinuclear hof set away from the nucleus and form comet-like rows, and are keratin-negative.
Megakaryocytes are single cells with one large lobulated nucleus and pink granular cytoplasm, not several separate round nuclei in shared blue cytoplasm.

ddx.dx: Hematolymphoid neoplasm (e.g., ALCL or large cell lymphoma)
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells are dyscohesive with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and express CD45 or lineage markers rather than cytokeratin.
